title_hi: सहानुभूति: अध्ययन वास्तव में क्या मापते हैं?
topic: empathy measurement, self-report, empathic accuracy, affective response, physiological and neural correlates, and interpretation limits
unique_angle: Empathy studies measure different slices—reported tendency, target-agreement accuracy, own affect, or correlates—not one universal empathy meter.
evidence_class: peer-reviewed empathy measurement study plus systematic reviews of assessment instruments and psychometric quality
safety_boundary: Public education only. Task outcomes and questionnaire scores are context-bound and are not diagnosis, treatment, direct thought reading, personal ranking, or a universal measure of empathy.
